# langsmith_bulk_exports (Data Source)

Lists all LangSmith bulk export jobs in a workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every bulk export job in the workspace.
data "langsmith_bulk_exports" "all" {}

output "bulk_export_ids" {
  value = [for e in data.langsmith_bulk_exports.all.bulk_exports : e.id]
}

# Only the exports that are still running.
output "running_bulk_exports" {
  value = [
    for e in data.langsmith_bulk_exports.all.bulk_exports : e.id
    if e.status == "Running"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID to list bulk exports from. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `bulk_exports` (Attributes List) The bulk exports in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bulk_exports))

<a id="nestedatt--bulk_exports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bulk_exports`

Read-Only:

- `all_experiments` (Boolean) Whether the export covers all experiments rather than a single session.
- `bulk_export_destination_id` (String) The UUID of the bulk export destination the export writes to.
- `compression` (String) The compression type (`none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, or `zstandard`).
- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `end_time` (String) The end time of the exported window, in RFC3339 format.
- `export_fields` (List of String) The list of run fields included in the export.
- `filter` (String) The filter expression applied to the exported runs.
- `finished_at` (String) The timestamp when the export finished.
- `format` (String) The export format (e.g. `Parquet`).
- `format_version` (String) The format version (`v1` or `v2_beta`).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the bulk export.
- `interval_hours` (Number) The interval in hours for recurring exports.
- `session_id` (String) The UUID of the project/session being exported.
- `source_bulk_export_id` (String) The UUID of the bulk export this export was derived from, for scheduled/interval exports.
- `start_time` (String) The start time of the exported window, in RFC3339 format.
- `status` (String) The status of the bulk export (`Created`, `Running`, `Completed`, `Cancelled`, `Failed`, `TimedOut`, or `IntervalScheduled`).
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID that owns the bulk export.
